abilities.desc: Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)

abilities.name: Iron Stomach
abilities.desc: Reduce your risk of food poisoning. Push Through gives temporary protection from unsafe food.

abilities.name: Phoenix Clause
abilities.desc: When you would die: the clause burns a RANDOM living villager of yours — body and all, no corpse, only ash — and you emerge from their ashes wherever they were, at 1 HP. The fire cannot take another bearer: only bearers left, and your death sticks. No villagers left, or no village, and your death sticks. Their gear survives the fire where they fell — it belongs to the village now, not to you. Pocket it and the village will judge you; bring it home to Haven and they will honor you. The devoted may offer themselves willingly; the resentful may fight the pull. Use it twice and the village will judge you: earn their love or be exiled. The cost is plain. The horror is knowing and doing it anyway.

abilities.name: Feast Engine
abilities.desc: While at full health: +25% damage. The body is a furnace at full burn. Stay topped up, hit harder.

abilities.name: Dowsing
abilities.desc: A forked stick twitches toward water. Works 70% of the time. Nobody knows why. Including us.
